question: What quantity of mantra recitation is prescribed for these deities using their own seed names?
premises: Recitation is designated by their own seed syllables.
The prescribed measure is one hundred thousand syllables.
This recitation is declared for those deities.
inference: Each deity requires a recitation of one hundred thousand syllables using its own seed name.
plain_english: For them, a recitation of one hundred thousand syllables, named by their own seed syllables, is declared.
